title: VisualSphinx: Large-Scale Synthetic Vision Logic Puzzles for RL
abstract: arXiv:2505.23977v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) are expected to perform effective multimodal reasoning and make logically coherent decisions, which is critical to tasks such as diagram understanding and spatial problem solving. However, current VLM reasoning lacks large-scale and well-structured training datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualSphinx, a first-of-its-kind large-scale synthetic visual logical reasoning training dataset. To tackle the challenge of image synthesis with grounded answers, we propose a rule-to-image synthesis pipeline that extracts and expands puzzle rules from seed questions and generates executable rendering programs for puzzle assembly. Using standard GRPO with binary correctness rewards as a validation recipe, experiments show that VLMs trained on VisualSphinx benefit from the logical coherence and readability of our dataset and exhibit improved performance on logical reasoning tasks. translated_title: VisualSphinx：用于强化学习的大规模合成视觉逻辑谜题数据集
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被期望能够执行有效的多模态推理并做出逻辑连贯的决策，这对于图表理解和空间问题求解等任务至关重要。然而，当前的VLM推理缺乏大规模且结构良好的训练数据集。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VisualSphinx，这是首个此类的大规模合成视觉逻辑推理训练数据集。为了解决带有真实答案支撑的图像合成这一挑战，我们提出了一种从规则到图像的合成流程，该流程从种子问题中提取并扩展谜题规则，并生成可执行的渲染程序以完成谜题的组装。使用标准的GRPO结合二元正确性奖励作为验证方案，实验表明，在VisualSphinx上训练的VLM受益于该数据集的逻辑连贯性和可读性，在逻辑推理任务上表现出性能提升。
tldr: VisualSphinx是首个大规模合成视觉逻辑推理训练数据集，通过从规则到图像的合成流程生成带有真实答案的视觉逻辑谜题，经强化学习训练后可显著提升视觉语言模型的逻辑推理能力。
en_tdlr: VisualSphinx is the first-of-its-kind large-scale synthetic visual logical reasoning training dataset that uses a rule-to-image synthesis pipeline to generate vision logic puzzles with grounded answers, and RL training on it improves VLMs' logical reasoning performance.
